actions.message: Great job contributing a lot! Keep it up.

answer.explanation: Resident6 contributed less than 10% of endowment for two consecutive rounds, triggering the punishment rule. A private message praises Resident3 for high contribution.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action round12. According to constitution: baseline 80% of wallet unless avg<30% then extra 30%. Wallet 387.5, 80% =310. Need check avg contribution round12: contributions: Resident1 60, Resident2 87.73, Resident3 215.18, Resident4 60, Resident5 0, Resident6 0. Total =422.91 pool includes contributions total? sum = 60+87.73+215.18+60+0+0=422.91 matches total_pool. Average =422.91/6 =70.485. That's >45%, so baseline 80% contribution. So we should contribute 310 (80% of wallet). Also check punishment rule: Resident6 contributed 0 two consecutive rounds (11 and 12). That's <10% of endowment (10). Two consecutive, so punish Resident6 with amount 10 (severity). Cost to us = 10*0.3=3, we have enough wallet. We can do one physical action only; choose either contribute or punish. Constitution says punish free-riders. We can also do both? Max one physical action per round. Need choose. Which priority? Punish rule is specific, and contribution baseline also required. But can only do one. Probably choose punish because free-rider deterrence important. But we would then not contribute this round, violating baseline. Constitution maybe implies both? but limit says at most one physical action. Must pick. I'd pick punish because required by rule when condition met. Also broadcast norm every 5 rounds (round 10 was broadcast? round5,10,15... Actually rounds 1,5,9,13? rule says first round and every 5 rounds thereafter. That would be rounds 1,6,11,16. So round11 broadcast already done. Round12 not broadcast. So we can just punish.

Thus actions: punish Resident6 amount 10, and maybe also send private praise to high contributor Resident3 (contributed 215). That's allowed one communication. So include private_message.

Return JSON.
